reviews.text: I recently had my backyard in Richardson transformed by a pool builder, and the experience was fantastic. Being new to the area, I was lucky to have Thomas, the designer, come out and discuss ideas for my pool and landscaping. Thomas really understood what I wanted right from the start and returned with a pool design and estimate that exceeded my expectations. He was very professional, creative, and always made sure I felt comfortable with each step. The finished backyard looks incredible, and we couldn't be happier. The whole team followed through on every promise, kept the construction on schedule, and even went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. Every person we worked with, from Adam to Bill and the whole office staff, was friendly and helpful throughout the process. I highly recommend them if you're looking for a pool builder in Richardson—they truly are the best!
reviews.author: Ethan Welch

reviews.text: My husband and I hired a pool cleaning company in Richardson and we’re extremely happy with our choice. When we were looking for pool cleaning services, we did consider a few other companies that offered cheaper rates, but we later found out that one of them didn’t do a great job for someone we know. We’re so glad we went with this team instead. You really get what you pay for! Here’s what stood out to us: 1) They provided a helpful 3D preview of what our pool area would look like after cleaning and servicing, which matched the final result almost exactly. 2) The whole team was great to work with—very friendly and professional. You could tell right away that they cared about doing a good job, and the results showed it. 3) We got weekly updates by email about our pool cleaning schedule, so we always knew what was happening next. 4) Christopher took the time to walk us through every step and answered all of our questions. We also chose a few extra services, like special tile cleaning, that made a big difference in the end. 5) Somehow, after their service, our backyard pool area actually looked bigger and more inviting! 6) We can be pretty particular, but this team truly delivered perfection. We highly recommend this pool cleaning company. Our pool and backyard in Richardson look absolutely stunning, and our friends and family can’t believe how beautiful everything turned out.
reviews.author: Kristin C

reviews.text: We recently had a pool and a new outdoor living space designed and built by Richardson Blue Pools & Spas, and we couldn't be happier with how everything turned out! From the start, the building process went very smoothly. The pool construction was finished quickly, and as soon as one phase was completed, the next team came in right away to keep things moving. When it was time to create the outdoor living area, there were some unexpected delays because of a subcontractor, but the main team really went above and beyond for us. Bill and the crew stayed in close contact, made sure any issues were quickly fixed, and brought in another team to make sure the work was done right and up to a high standard. The final results are even better than we expected. Every time we had a concern or needed something adjusted, they listened carefully and made sure we were satisfied. Bill kept us updated and answered all our questions along the way. Even though the whole project took a bit longer, we appreciate how committed everyone was to making sure our backyard turned out perfect. Now we have a beautiful pool and outdoor area that's just right for enjoying the Texas sunshine with our family and friends!
reviews.author: phillip hodge

reviews.text: andrew and his crew are absolutely fantastic! they finished a big pool renovation project quickly and the quality was outstanding. i would definitely recommend richardson blue pools & spas to anyone in richardson who wants a top-notch job resurfacing their pool. they really made our backyard look amazing for the texas heat.
reviews.author: Dominique Moon

reviews.text: After a leak detection indicated there was a problem along the bottom of my pool’s tile line, I reached out for pool cleaning and repair services in Richardson. They sent Austin, who quickly figured out that my pool needed to be resurfaced. The team set up a time to start, arrived right on schedule, and finished the whole resurfacing project in just five days. Every day, a different specialist came to take care of their part of the work, and everything ran smoothly, almost like clockwork. Throughout the process, the crew explained exactly what they were doing, answered all my questions, cleaned up after themselves, and made sure I understood how they would fix the leak. Now, months later, my pool is still holding water perfectly. The team that applied the new pool surface did an outstanding job. It was impressive to see so many workers come in, each handling their task efficiently. They even went the extra mile—covering my neighbor’s car with plastic to keep it clean from dust, and they power washed my patio, leaving it cleaner than when they started. I also signed up for a 30-day pool service so they could check the chemicals and clean my pool twice a week during the first month after the repair. There was one week when the regular person couldn’t make it, but they quickly sent a replacement and even added an extra cleaning day to make up for it. I decided to upgrade to a white LED pool light, which cost $800. While it felt a bit pricey, I’m still very happy with the results. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with the pool cleaning and repair service I received. The office staff was friendly and easy to work with, and the technicians were knowledgeable, professional, and dedicated to making sure my pool was in great shape.
reviews.author: Reagan Malone

reviews.text: Getting a pool built by Richardson Blue Pools & Spas was an incredible experience from beginning to end. From the first meeting to the final walkthrough, everything went smoothly and there were no issues at all. The project was completed much faster than we expected. Our sales representative, Adam, was friendly, professional, and always ready to answer our questions or help us out. We also needed some help with septic planning, and they connected us with great resources and kept us updated throughout the process. Our site manager, Thomas, was outstanding—always respectful of our property, easy to communicate with, and kept us informed every step of the way. After checking out several pool builders, this company truly went above and beyond our expectations. We absolutely love our new pool, especially with the hot Texas weather!
reviews.author: G Roach

reviews.text: we had richardson blue pools & spas design and build a custom pool in our backyard here in richardson. anthony was excellent from start to finish. we got estimates from other pool builders that looked a bit cheaper, but we were really impressed with anthony’s design ideas and how he promised to stay involved until the pool was finished. with other companies, we noticed the sales person would disappear after signing. anthony was always there for us. the team on site was friendly, professional, and worked hard every day. our pool was finished right on schedule. we’re very happy with how everything turned out—the design, the build quality, and how smooth the whole process was. highly recommend for anyone wanting a beautiful pool in a texas backyard.
reviews.author: carly price

reviews.text: After researching several pool remodel companies, I’m glad I picked the right team for my fiberglass pool renovation. Their attention to detail and clear communication throughout the project really stood out. Even with a rainy day, they still managed to complete the pool on schedule, which was a pleasant surprise since other pool builders I’ve worked with before didn’t always finish on time. I’m thrilled with how my pool looks now and would absolutely choose this company again for any future pool projects. I only wish I had decided to do the remodel sooner!
reviews.author: jaime shannon

reviews.text: I needed my pool replastered, so I got a few quotes around Richardson. Anthony was the only one who noticed that the crack behind my tile was actually caused by an issue with the coping, not just something that could be patched up. The job took removing quite a bit of coping to redo the mortar properly. They even managed to find a few tiles that matched my old vintage ones, which was great—some were a little chipped, but it was definitely better than having to retile the entire pool, and I love the classic look. The pool looks amazing now with the new Stonescapes finish and the repaired tile. After the first fill, I had a small issue, but Anthony made sure a crew came out right away to take care of it. I appreciate them handling everything quickly and making sure I was happy with the results. It’s good to know how well things are handled if any issues pop up, not just when everything goes smoothly.
reviews.author: leonard baldwin

reviews.text: After working with many companies on different home construction projects over the years, I can honestly say that having our pool built by this team was one of the best experiences I’ve had. From the start, John, our sales person, did an amazing job designing our pool and helping us pick out the right equipment and materials. The final result is a beautiful pool that has really impressed all our neighbors. Thomas managed the construction process and was always on time and kept us updated at every step. Building a pool involves many different crews, and everyone who worked on our project paid close attention to detail and worked really hard. We are so happy with our new pool and backyard! Just a heads up—when the construction starts, your backyard might look a little rough for a while, but the finished pool is definitely worth it. We absolutely love our new outdoor space!
reviews.author: Camila M

reviews.text: It’s been a while since company: Richardson Blue Pools & Spas cleaned and repaired my pool, and everything still looks and works like new. I’m really happy with how well the pool has held up. They fixed all the problems left by the last company, and the results have been great. I just wish I had found them sooner for pool cleaning and repairs. The service was top-notch, and I’m impressed with the quality and care they put into their work.
reviews.author: Ronnie V

reviews.text: we had a great experience working with alex and tom at Richardson Blue Pools & Spas. alex did an amazing job designing the pool exactly how we pictured it, even after i changed my mind several times along the way. he was always patient and quick to update the design to match what we wanted. tom was our project manager and made sure everything happened right on schedule, whether the sun was shining or it was raining. he listened to any suggestions we had and made sure any concerns were taken care of immediately. after the pool was finished, they also helped us with some landscaping and the new sod looked great. overall, the team made the whole pool building process smooth and enjoyable, and we are really happy with our backyard now.
reviews.author: Ashton R

reviews.text: We received a fantastic design for our backyard pool in Richardson in no time at all. Adam, our designer, was extremely patient and always ready to assist with any changes we wanted. He really knew his stuff, especially when it came to explaining details that could affect the cost, like where to place the pool pump. I highly recommend this pool builder to anyone looking to create their dream pool in Texas!
reviews.author: Michelle Stanton

reviews.text: After having a rough experience with another pool builder, I was searching for someone reliable to finish my backyard pool project here in Richardson. Most companies didn’t want to take on a job that was already started, but Tom from the team came out right away and listened to my concerns. He walked me through a solid plan to get my pool completed and even suggested ways to help save on costs, since I had already paid once before. Throughout the whole process, Tom kept me updated at every stage and was always quick to answer any questions I had. The quality of work from Tom and his crew really impressed me, and now I trust them to handle my weekly pool maintenance as well. Everything has been worry-free since they took over. I can’t thank Tom and the team enough for turning my pool project around and making the whole process easy. If you’re in Richardson and need a dependable pool builder or someone to service your pool, I highly recommend them. Their honesty and professionalism really stand out.
reviews.author: Ebony E

reviews.text: I’m extremely happy with my entire experience with Richardson Blue Pools & Spas. They handled a full restoration of my pool, including cleaning and refreshing everything so it looked brand new. From the beginning, the team was respectful, kept me updated on their work, and always left the area clean after each stage. After the job was done, Blake came by to help take care of the new pool and answered all my questions about pool maintenance, which made me feel confident about keeping it in great shape. Austin also helped me choose the right tiles and coping, and made sure I understood every step of the process. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free, and my pool looks fantastic now!
reviews.author: Khloe Hunter

reviews.text: We spent a lot of time researching and meeting with different pool builders before choosing who to trust with our new backyard pool. Since this wasn't our first pool project, we knew exactly what we wanted and expected high standards in design, quality, and how everything was put together. We wanted our pool to look amazing and be built to last, so we weren’t willing to settle for anything less than great craftsmanship. From my first meeting with Bill, it was clear he really understood what customers want and was dedicated to making sure every detail was just right. Bill kept the communication open throughout the whole process and listened to all my feedback, whether it was suggestions or concerns. In a big project like this, there are always challenges, but every time I brought something up, Bill and his team responded quickly and took care of it. Our project manager, Anthony, was also fantastic—always ready to answer my questions and keep me in the loop at every step. The final result is a beautiful pool that not only matched our vision but even went beyond what we hoped for in some ways. If you’re looking for a pool builder in Texas that combines top-notch customer service with excellent quality, I highly recommend this team.
reviews.author: B Rodriquez

reviews.text: We absolutely love our new pool! It was definitely worth waiting for. The designer, Anthony, really listened to our ideas and helped us achieve the exact look we wanted. He was professional and very patient throughout the whole process. Tom was also fantastic—the service we received from him was truly outstanding. He kept us updated at every step and made sure all our questions were answered. We couldn't have asked for a better experience from a pool builder in Texas, especially with the hot weather here. Highly recommend this team for anyone looking to build a beautiful backyard pool!
reviews.author: Gloria H

reviews.text: We have an infinity pool with a hot tub in Richardson. Our pool was getting pretty old and the bottom was starting to flake, so it really needed some attention. We reached out for an estimate and Ardie came by to help us figure out the best options. Ardie brought a variety of samples and took careful measurements of the pool. We decided to move forward with the resurfacing, and we’re so glad we did. The whole team, from the demo crew to the resurfacing experts, did an excellent job and made sure to clean up everything when they finished. The pool looks fantastic now—better than we imagined! We would definitely recommend their pool services to anyone looking for quality work in Richardson. Even our regular pool technician was impressed and said he would recommend them too!
reviews.author: Alison Wiley
